title: pvGhostCells
body:
## pvGhostCells

Generates ghost cells and points: layers of neighbouring cells copied from adjacent blocks of a partitioned dataset or from other MPI processes, marked with vtkGhostType. Supported block types are image, rectilinear, structured, polydata and unstructured grids (and hyper tree grids). Use it before filters that need neighbour information across partition boundaries, such as gradients or smoothing, so results do not show seams; remove the layers afterwards with pvRemoveGhostInformation.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Ghosts are exchanged only between partitions of the same partitioned dataset, not between different datasets of a collection.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI or client-server behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GhostCells`. Identity: `filters/GhostCells`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input. Accepted data: composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BuildIfRequired` | Specify if the filter must generate the ghost cells only if required by the pipeline downstream. To force at least a fixed level of ghosts, this must be set to 0 (unchecked). | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateGlobalIds` | Specify if the filter should generate global ids when generating ghost cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `GenerateProcessIds` | Specify if the filter should generate process ids when generating ghost cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MinimumNumberOfGhosts` | When **BuildIfRequired** if off, use this to specify the minimum number of ghost cells to request. The filter may request more ghost levels than indicated if a downstream filter asked for more ghost levels. | `{"maximum":100,"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `SynchronizeOnly` | Specify if the filter should only try to synchronize ghost data. If On, it assumes the number of ghost layer should not change. If On, but conditions are not met (ghosts, gids and pids), it will fallback on the default behavior: generating ghosts. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
